patthana23.12:1.1: na kusalaṃ na parittārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato parittārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana23.12:2.1: na kusalaṃ na mahaggatārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā kusalo mahaggatārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā nava.
patthana23.12:3.1: na kusalaṃ na appamāṇārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā kusalo appamāṇārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā cha. nakusalattika nahīnattike kusalattika hīnattikaṃ
